photo.bodyLead: Once is enough; we show all your looks on you with this photo.
photo.faceLead: Your figure's face comes from this photo; the same photo also unlocks your colour palette.
photo.tipBackgroundBody: A plain wall or a door is enough.
photo.tipFrameBody: Step back 2–3 steps; phone at waist height.
photo.tipLightBody: Face the daylight; no light from behind.
photo.faceTipGlasses: No glasses; hair off your face

photo.offlineTitle: Your photo is waiting on your phone
photo.offlineBody: When you're back online the upload continues where it stopped; no need to wait on this screen. Your consent is saved.

bodyType.title: Choose the body type closest to yours
bodyType.lead: We build your figure from your face photo, height and size. There is no right or wrong.
bodyType.choose: Choose a body type; "Not sure" is a choice too.
bodyType.heightError: Enter a height between 100 and 230 cm.
bodyType.note: Saved to your profile, asked once. Change it any time in Profile › Size.

desc.hourglass: Shoulders and hips about as wide, a more defined waist.
desc.apple: Volume around the middle of the body.
desc.rectangle: Shoulders, waist and hips close to each other.
desc.unsure: That's fine. We use a balanced figure from your height and size; you can change it later.

descMen.rectangle: Shoulders, waist and hips about the same width.
descMen.inverted_triangle: Clearly broad shoulders; a narrower waist and hips.
descMen.triangle: Hips and waist wider than the shoulders.
descMen.oval: Volume gathers in the middle, around the waist.
descMen.trapezoid: Shoulders a little wider than the hips, a balanced waist.

rejected.body: We didn't keep the photo and no credit was used. These usually help:

notFullBody.a: Get your feet in the frame too; step back 2–3 steps.
notFullBody.b: Hold the phone upright at waist height or use the timer.

tooDark.a: Face the daylight; no light from behind.
tooDark.b: In the evening, stand under the ceiling light.

multiplePeople.a: Be the only person in the photo.
multiplePeople.b: In a mirror shot, make sure nobody is behind you.

blurry.a: Hold the phone still or lean it on something.
blurry.b: Tap the screen once to focus the camera.

noFace.b: No glasses; hair off your face.
